treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the State of Israel and the Government of the People's Republic of China for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1995, with protocol)
eif_quote: Came into force on 22 December 1995, i.e., the thirtieth day after the Parties had informed each other ... [UNTS footnote]; Article 29: This Agreement shall have effect as respects income derived and capital during the taxable years beginning on or after the first day of January next following that in which this Agreement enters into force.
source_title: UN Treaty Series Vol. 1927, No. I-32885 (Israel and China, English authentic text, registered by Israel)

rates.quote: However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident, and according to the laws of that contracting State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, and according to the laws of that Contracting State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed: a. 7% of the gross amount of the interest if it is received by any bank or financial institution; b. 10% of the gross amount of the interest in all other cases.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, and according to the laws of that Contracting State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: [MLI Art. 7(1)] Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction ...

notes: Interest: 7% cap where the interest is received by any bank or financial institution (Art. 11(2)(a)) - bank-only tier not modelled. No exemption for government interest in Art. 11. Royalties for the use of industrial, commercial or scientific equipment: tax imposed on 70% of the gross amount (Protocol para 2), i.e. effective 7%. Protocol para 4: domestic anti-abuse denial of benefits. Israel reserved the entirety of MLI Art. 8 (Art. 8(3)(b)(iii)); treaty dividend article has a single rate anyway. MLI covered both sides (China list; Israel deposit position); both MLI in force, WHT effect 2023-01-01 per map.json (Art. 35(1)(a)); no Art. 35(7) reservation by either side.
